title: Iden Versio
subtitle: Inferno Squad Commander
text: Action [Exhaust]: If an enemy unit was defeated this phase, heal 1 damage from your base.
deployBox:
Shielded (When you deploy this leader, give her a Shield token.)

When an enemy unit is defeated: Heal 1 damage from your base.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Iden’s leader ability still can be used as an action even if no enemy unit left play this phase (but it heals no damage from your base).
If Iden is defeated simultaneously with other enemy units, you still get to heal damage.
